note: Election of the Newtownards Borough Council ('Ards'), 20 May 1964. In each ward the paper prints an aldermanic poll (one alderman) and a councillors' poll (three councillors); they are recorded as separate contests. Castle Ward is not printed in the table; the accompanying report says Labour's Mr. Samuel Gracey 'was returned unopposed', with no other names, so Castle Ward is not recorded. Percentage poll 55.
